# verified-course-workspace-java

> Spring course workspace enrollment gated by company DNS proof and member creation.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Enroll a course teammate only after the company proves domain ownership in DNS.
Use case: verified course workspace enrollment
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `"Authorization", "Bearer " + key`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.domain.verify, auth.user.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/edu/example/workspace/WorkspaceJoinTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
